entries.source: Urkundenbuch des Cistercienserstiftes B. Mariae V. zu Hohenfurt in Böhmen, Nr. XCI. , S. 106, XCI.
entries.german:
1348. 5. Juni. 0. A0. — Abt Thomas von Hohenfurl und der Convent daselbst verpflichten sich gegenüber den Herren Peter, Jodok, Virich und Johann von Rosenberg, von den Stiftsunterthanen nur im Nothfalle und auch dann nur mit Erlaubnis« der vorgenannten Herren Steuern und Abgaben zu erheben.

XCI. Erlaubnis« der vorgenannten Herren Steuern und Abgaben zu erheben. Ab humana memoria mundi negotia facilius elabuntur, que nee sigillis nee idoneo literarum testimonio perennantur. Nos igitur Гг. Thomas dictus abbas totusque conventus monusterii in Altovudo ordi- nis Cisterciensis notum facimus tenure praesontium universis, quod multimodas gratias, quibus nos nostrumque monasierium nee non ho mines haereditates possessiones ac bona nostra nobiles viri domini et fundatores nostri dilecti domini Petrus Jodocus Vlricus et Joannes fratres de Rosenberg gratiose et multum charitative ubilibet prose- rfiumtui', et praecipue seu maxime gratiam, quam nobis nostroque monasterio universis et singulis hominibus seu subditis nostris super libertate et absolutione omnium bernarum et impositionum steirarum et collectarum praesentium et futurarum circa excellentissimum prin- cipem dominum dominum Carolum regem Romanorum et Boemiae regem perpetue obtinentes impetrarunt, nos praesentibus submitti 93 mus bona et sincera fide nostra promittentes, quod nee nos nee suc- cessores nostri de universis et singulis bonis haereditatibus incolis praetacti nostri monasterii nullo unquam tempore et perpetue bernas steiras collectas ungeltum subsidia honores remunerationes et alias ¡mpositiones qualescunque aut quomodocunqne nuncupatos absque consensu et voluntate praedictorum dominorum et fundatorum no- strorum requirere exigere et exhortare debemus. Et si unquam neces sitate non modica nos urgente con tribu tionem seu steiram a predicti monasterii nostri paupèribus seu incolis aptare conaremur, banc ex fauore et licentia praedictorum dominorum et fundatorum nostrorum obtinendo ipsam in usus nostros ac in meliorationem ac sublevamon praetacti nostri monasterii juxta ipsorum consilia disponere et con verter« tenebimur et spondemus. In cuius rei testimonium et evi- dentiam clariorem praesentem eis literam tradidimus sigillorum no strorum munimine roboratam. Datum anno domini MCCCXLVIII. in octava ascensionis domini. Nach Kühbeck Diplom. I, 190, der die Abschrift aus einem von ihm nicht näher bezeichneten he. Codex der Stiftsbibliothek nahm.
entries.english:
1348, 5 June. — Abbot Thomas of Hohenfurt and the convent undertake toward Lords Peter, Jodok, Virich, and Hans von Rosenberg that they will levy taxes and dues from the monastery's subjects only in case of necessity, and then only with the permission of the aforesaid lords.

Human affairs more easily slip from memory unless they are made lasting by seals or suitable written testimony. Therefore we, Brother Thomas, called abbot, and the whole convent of the monastery at Hohenfurt of the Cistercian Order, make known to all through the present document that noble men, our beloved lords and founders, Lords Peter, Jodok, Ulrich, and Johann, brothers von Rosenberg, have graciously and charitably bestowed many favors everywhere upon us and our monastery, our people, inheritances, possessions, and goods. In particular, and most especially, they obtained for us, our monastery, and all our people or subjects perpetual freedom and exemption from all present and future bernas, taxes, and collections under the most illustrious prince Lord Charles, King of the Romans and of Bohemia. By this document, in good faith, we promise that neither we nor our successors shall ever, at any time or in perpetuity, demand, exact, or solicit from any of the goods, inheritances, inhabitants, or people of our aforesaid monastery any bernas, taxes, collections, ungelt, subsidies, honors, remunerations, or other impositions, whatever they may be called or in whatever way imposed, without the consent and will of the aforesaid lords and founders. If ever, under pressure of some great necessity, we should attempt to impose a tax or contribution on the poor people or inhabitants of our aforesaid monastery, we undertake and promise to do so only with the favor and permission of the aforesaid lords and founders, and to use and apply it for our own purposes and for the improvement and relief of our monastery according to their counsel. In witness and clearer proof of this matter, we have delivered this present document to them, strengthened by the protection of our seals. Given in the year of the Lord 1348, on the octave of the Ascension of the Lord.

According to Kühbeck, Diplom. I, 190, who took the copy from a manuscript codex of the monastery library that he did not identify more precisely.
